scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.

rules.A: best reward on the parent environment (ties: shallowest)

measure: exaptation (D6 rule) on OTHER_ENVS minus the parent environment, same set for both rules
statistic: paired sign-flip over parents of exaptive(B) - exaptive(A); Wilson bands of each rate
continuation: selection on each held-out world in turn
